dismissed.reason: misreads-source: The guide's anatomy says the panel "stacks a status icon, a title, one line of detail, and an optional row of buttons". Only the buttons are called optional, so marking Icon alwaysPresent=false misreads it.
dismissed.by: Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5), overnight run agentpack-batch10, on the extraction’s behalf; for Astra and Marcin to confirm
dismissed.why: In this pack an anatomy part's required means the package always renders it (agent-pack/README.md, Decisions: false for an optional prop or slot). CardFeedback renders only the children it is given (children?: React.ReactNode, CardFeedback.tsx line 32, 0.1.78-dbe0e02; rendered as given at lines 124 and 128), and CardFeedback.Icon is a separate part people compose (lines 147–170, attached at 258), so a card without it has no icon. The guide's anatomy and its Message only state put an icon on every card it shows, and the entry keeps that in the Configuration rule “Build it from the card’s parts”, the Do “Match the icon to the status” and all three examples. Nudge's and Empty State's composed parts are recorded the same way, and reviews/attached.json dismisses the same question for Attached.
